description: An independently constructed weighted-divergence and Rees complex agrees with the direct determinant complex through quartic order and reproduces the recorded Hilbert prefix and filtered generator counts.

independent_review.scope: No independent review is represented in this public record.

manuscript_coverage.coverage_rule: Complete coverage requires an exact LaTeX location for every program-relevant defining claim. A locator records where the current statement and evidence boundary appear; it is not a proof-review status.

members.statement: For the normalized degree-seven counterexample, an independently constructed marked-root weighted-divergence/Rees complex agrees over Q with the direct determinant complex through parameter order four, giving Hilbert prefix (1,10,44,108,157) and filtered generator counts 11,13,11.
members.title: Marked-Root Source Flows Reconstruct the Kuranishi Ideal Through Quartic Order

members.statement: A torus-stable 337-dimensional slice has ten tangent parameters of weights (-1,2,-3,-2,-1,0,1,1,2,3); exact positive, negative, and fixed-weight obstruction certificates plus a torus-nullcone lemma show that its reduced completed local ring is C. Thus G is reduced-affinely rigid in K_{3,7}, though the local ring is a nonreduced Artin thickening.
